law_verbatim.sweep_validity_1a: a sweep over a single driver is VALID as an independence instrument only if its pairwise |rho| matrix contains at least one pair reading at or below the R5 ceiling of 0.80. A sweep in which every measured pair tracks above the ceiling is recorded as SWEEP_DEGENERATE_UNDER_DRIVER and yields no independence evidence in either direction — it may not disturb a verdict and may not support one. Rationale, declared before any matrix was read: rank correlation along a monotone driver is 1.0 by construction for any two monotonically-responding axes; divergence somewhere in the matrix is the only demonstration that the instrument resolves difference rather than restating the driver's own ordering — the sweep-space analogue of the documented N=4 census degeneracy. This condition is SYMMETRIC: it can void the number that threatens three verdicts and it can equally void a number that would have rescued one.
law_verbatim.containment_1e: a NOT_COMMON_DRIVER conclusion — reached because a counted axis's response to a driver falls under its qualification threshold — is valid ONLY if the swept range contains the interval between the two families' values of that driver for that pair (render-effective values where a side declares but never arrives; for a block absent by structure, the interval runs from the block-absent effective value to the block-present value, and the sweep must span it; a scale or shape member of an absent block has no absent-side value — its containment is governed by the block's amplitude member). If the range contains the interval, the reading stands and a wider sweep adds nothing: wider sweeps measure products that do not exist. If it does not, the reading is UNTESTED_AT_SEPARATING_STIMULUS, not NOT_COMMON_DRIVER, and the driver must be re-swept over at least the containing interval before the pair may be ruled. The criterion is containment, not width — checkable geometry, not judgment.
law_verbatim.conservation_1f: for each pair and each counted axis, the axis's measured inter-family effect must be accountable by the union of the swept drivers' measured spans over their inter-family intervals. If the measured effect materially exceeds what every enumerated driver can produce across the interval that actually separates the families, the driver enumeration is proven incomplete and the residual must be named — a specific parameter, a specific builder constant, or UNACCOUNTED_CAUSE. A pair carrying an UNACCOUNTED_CAUSE residual may not be a clean PASS: its honest status is PASS_WITH_UNTESTED_DRIVER with the residual magnitude stated, because an unenumerated cause is by definition an untested driver. Rationale declared before the numbers: NOT_COMMON_DRIVER is a null result discharging a safety condition, and this project has been wrong three times in exactly that pattern (the sub-pixel zero, the silent zero on RAKING_SHADOW_FRACTION, the constant-vector rank correlation). Conservation converts 'we found nothing' into a bounded claim about how much there was to find.
law_verbatim.guard_1g: no rank correlation may be computed in this codebase against a zero-variance vector — the guard RAISES rather than returning a number. Defect class registered as DEGENERATE_INPUT_PLAUSIBLE_OUTPUT (third of its kind after the N=4 census degeneracy and the silent-zero floor), alongside DECLARED_BUT_UNREALIZED and BUILDER_CONSTANT. The guarded implementation (palette_statistics.guarded_spearman) is the only path by which a correlation may be computed.

inventory_findings.the_finding: for the overwhelming majority of committed threshold verdicts — including every cross-family effect clearing behind every committed pair PASS — no replicate spread of the deciding statistic has ever been measured. The seed-only floors are spreads of a DIFFERENT statistic (same-family noise), used as proxies. This is a finding, not a gap filled by assumption.
